messages:
Maya Chen: Morning team — quick heads-up for today's KPI sync. The weekly dashboard shows CAC up ~18% for webinar-driven leads and demo signups attribution seems to have shifted toward \"organic\" vs our paid channels. Anyone else seeing weird attribution jumps?
Anna Rivera: saw that. Dashboard link: https://redwood.app/insights/kpis — I think GA4 UTM normalization broke for a subset of paid URLs — case sensitivity and `utm_medium` set to `cpc` vs `paid`. Ran quick query:
```
SELECT utm_source, utm_medium, COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE event='registration' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10;
```
Anna Rivera: results show `Paid` and `paid` split, plus some `cpc` rows.
Liam O'Neill: HubSpot mapping uses raw utm fields to set lead_source. If GA data is split, HS will create multiple buckets. I can patch a normalization rule but need a sample list of affected URLs.
Owen Patel: we should re-run attribution with a normalized source field and also compare last-touch vs algorithmic multi-touch. I can spin up the attribution job if someone confirms normalization.
Priya Kapoor: FYI conversion from webinar -> demo down 12% after last week's landing copy test. Maybe landing copy change reduced CTA clarity. Landing variant B rolled 3/14 — correlates timing.
Tom Brooks: If routing changed, some demo leads might be going to the SDR queue instead of AE. @liam can you confirm HubSpot workflows?
Liam O'Neill: looking — there's a workflow that checks `lead_source = "webinar"` and routes to SDR. That workflow uses `utm_source` exact match. I'll add normalization and then re-run the workflow on recent leads (backfill).
AnalyticsBot: Daily KPI snapshot — webinar registrants: 1,230 (+4% wrt last week), webinar->demo conversion: 6.8% (-11% wrt last week), paid CAC: $420 (+18%).
Maya Chen: Proposed action items: 1) Normalize UTM fields in GA -> owner @Anna (blocked by list of affected URLs) 2) Update HubSpot mapping + backfill routing -> owner @Liam 3) Re-run attribution with normalized keys and multi-touch model -> owner @Owen 4) AB-check landing copy variant impact and consider rolling back -> owner @Priya. Can folks confirm owners and ETA? :white_check_mark: 
Anna Rivera: I can extract the URL list by EOD and push a normalization PR to our analytics pipeline tomorrow morning.
Liam O'Neill: will update HS mapping today and start a backfill job — ETA EOD. I'll post the exact workflow changes here.
Owen Patel: once Anna's normalization is in, I'll run the multi-touch job and share a diff of attribution impacts — aim for tomorrow afternoon.
Priya Kapoor: I'll pull session recordings and landing heatmaps, and propose a quick copy tweak. If we roll back, target to deploy before Friday's webinar.
Maya Chen: Great — let's do a 15-min huddle at 10:30 to sync on progress. Added calendar invite. Thanks :raised_hands: 
Tom Brooks: cool, will review routing once @Liam posts changes.
